lint_script =: 3 : 0
    replacementwords =. targets =. usedgroups =. 0$a:
    for_box. Pres do. replacementwords =. replacementwords,1{::>box end.
    for_box. Items do.
        item =. >box
        if. (0{item)e.;:'GOTO RESTATE' do. targets =. targets,0{2{::item end.
    end.
    count =. #Keywords
    reach =. =/~i.count
    for_index. i.count do.
        keyword =. index{::Keywords
        for_ruleid. 4{::keyword do.
            for_itemid. 3{::ruleid{::Rules do.
                item =. itemid{::Items
                if. (0{item)e.;:'GOTO RESTATE' do.
                    target =. 0{2{::item
                    if. target e.KeywordWords do. reach =. 1 (<index,KeywordWords i.target)}reach end.
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    for_k. i.count do. reach =. reach+.((k{"1 reach)*/k{reach) end.
    for_box. Rules do.
        for_elementbox. 1{::>box do.
            element =. >elementbox
            if. '@'={.element do. usedgroups =. usedgroups,<}.element end.
        end.
    end.
    for_box. Keywords do.
        'word rank line memories decomps' =. >box
        if. 0=#decomps do. add_diagnostic (<line),(<'KEY_NO_DECOMP'),<'keyword ',word,' has no DECOMP' end.
        if. word has_key PreTable do.
            if. (-.(<word)e.replacementwords)*.-.(<word)e.targets do.
                add_diagnostic (<line),(<'KEY_UNREACHABLE'),<'keyword ',word,' is replaced by PRE'
            end.
        end.
    end.
    for_box. Groups do.
        'name members line' =. >box
        if. -.(<name)e.usedgroups do. add_diagnostic (<line),(<'SYNON_UNUSED'),<'group ',name,' is never used' end.
    end.
    for_box. Pres do.
        'source replacement line' =. >box
        for_wordbox. replacement do.
            word =. >wordbox
            if. word has_key PreTable do. add_diagnostic (<line),(<'PRE_CHAIN'),<'replacement ',word,' is itself replaced by PRE' end.
        end.
    end.
    for_keywordid. i.count do.
        'word rank line memories decomps' =. keywordid{::Keywords
        for_idsbox. (<memories),<decomps do.
            ids =. >idsbox
            for_position. i.#ids do.
                'kind pattern ruleline itemids' =. (position{ids){::Rules
                unknown =. unknown_groups pattern
                for_groupbox. unknown do. add_diagnostic (<ruleline),(<'SYNON_UNKNOWN'),<'unknown group ',>groupbox end.
                if. 0=#itemids do. add_diagnostic (<ruleline),(<'RULE_NO_REASM'),<'rule has no reassembly' end.
                if. 0=#unknown do.
                    for_earlierid. position{.ids do.
                        earlier =. earlierid{::Rules
                        if. 0=#unknown_groups 1{::earlier do.
                            if. (1{::earlier) pattern_covers pattern do.
                                add_diagnostic (<ruleline),(<'RULE_SHADOWED'),<'pattern is shadowed by line ',number 2{::earlier
                                break.
                            end.
                        end.
                    end.
                end.
                wildcards =. +/is_wildcard&>pattern
                for_itemid. itemids do.
                    item =. itemid{::Items
                    itemline =. 3{::item
                    for_reference. item_references item do.
                        if. (reference=0)+.reference>wildcards do.
                            add_diagnostic (<itemline),(<'REF_UNBOUND'),<'reference (',(number reference),') is not bound'
                        end.
                    end.
                    if. (0{item)e.;:'GOTO RESTATE' do.
                        target =. 0{::2{::item
                        targetid =. KeywordWords i.<target
                        if. targetid=count do. add_diagnostic (<itemline),(<'TARGET_UNDEFINED'),<'target ',target,' is not a keyword'
                        elseif. (<targetid,keywordid){reach do.
                            add_diagnostic (<itemline),(<'TARGET_CYCLE'),<'edge ',word,' -> ',target,' is on a cycle'
                        end.
                    end.
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    orderkeys =. 0 3$0
    for_index. i.#Diagnostics do.
        diagnostic =. index{::Diagnostics
        orderkeys =. orderkeys,(0{::diagnostic),(CodeOrder i.1{diagnostic),index
    end.
    Diagnostics =: (/:orderkeys){Diagnostics
    i.0
)

normalize =: 3 : 0
    text =. tolower y
    text =. LF (I.text e.',.?!;')}text
    clauses =. 0$a:
    for_box. LF split text do.
        part =. >box
        part =. ' ' (I.-.part e.Lowercase,Digits,'''')}part
        words =. 0$a:
        for_wordbox. words_of part do.
            word =. >wordbox
            while. #word do.
                if. ''''~:{.word do. break. end.
                word =. }.word
            end.
            while. #word do.
                if. ''''~:{:word do. break. end.
                word =. }:word
            end.
            if. #word do. words =. words,<word end.
        end.
        if. #words do. clauses =. clauses,<words end.
    end.
    clauses
)

keyword_reply =: 3 : 0
    selected =. select_clause y
    if. selected=_1 do.
        DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'CLAUSE none'
        (<0),<'' return.
    end.
    original =. selected{::y
    keys =. keyword_list original
    labels =. 0$a:
    for_id. keys do. labels =. labels,0{id{::Keywords end.
    DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'CLAUSE ',(number selected+1),' ',' ' join original
    DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'KEYS ',' ' join labels
    keyword =. ({.keys){::Keywords
    found =. (3{::keyword) find_rule original
    if. 0{::found do.
        'matched rulenum ruleid bindings' =. found
        DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'MEMORY ',(0{::keyword),' ',number rulenum
        RuleHits =: (1+ruleid{RuleHits) ruleid}RuleHits
        if. #3{::ruleid{::Rules do.
            'itemnum item' =. take_item ruleid
            (0{::keyword) memory_store bindings build_reply 1{::item
        end.
    end.
    entered =. 0$0
    for_id. keys do.
        if. id e.entered do. continue. end.
        current =. id
        words =. original
        DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'ENTER ',0{::current{::Keywords
        while. 1 do.
            entered =. entered,current
            KeywordUses =: (1+current{KeywordUses) current}KeywordUses
            keyword =. current{::Keywords
            word =. 0{::keyword
            found =. (4{::keyword) find_rule words
            if. -.0{::found do.
                DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'NOMATCH ',word
                break.
            end.
            'matched rulenum ruleid bindings' =. found
            RuleHits =: (1+ruleid{RuleHits) ruleid}RuleHits
            if. 0=#3{::ruleid{::Rules do.
                DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'DECOMP ',word,' ',(number rulenum),' 0'
                break.
            end.
            'itemnum item' =. take_item ruleid
            DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'DECOMP ',word,' ',(number rulenum),' ',number itemnum
            'kind text args itemline' =. item
            if. kind-:'REASM' do.
                KeywordReplies =: (1+current{KeywordReplies) current}KeywordReplies
                Topics =: word increment_count Topics
                (<1),<bindings build_reply text return.
            elseif. kind-:'NEWKEY' do. break.
            end.
            target =. 0{::args
            targetid =. KeywordWords i.<target
            if. (targetid=#Keywords)+.targetid e.entered do.
                DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'BLOCKED ',target
                break.
            end.
            if. kind-:'RESTATE' do.
                words =. bindings restated_words }.args
                DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<' ' join (<'RESTATE'),(<target),words
            else. DecisionTrace =: DecisionTrace,<'GOTO ',target end.
            current =. targetid
        end.
    end.
    (<0),<''
)

            reply =. take_text 'QUESTION'
            source =. 2

debug_command =: 3 : 0
    parts =. ' ' split y
    name =. 0{::parts
    args =. }.parts
    text =. ' ' join args

    if. (<name)e.KeywordCommands do.

    select. name

        if. 0=#clauses do. output =. <'no words' end.

            key =. id{::Keywords

        end.
        output,(<'selected ',number selected+1),<'keys ',' ' join labels

        for_box. entries do.

        end.

    case. ':reflect' do.
        output =. 0$a:

    case. ':keys' do.
        ranks =. 0$0
        for_box. Keywords do. ranks =. ranks,1{::>box end.
        order =. /:(-ranks),./:/:KeywordWords
        labels =. 0$a:
        for_index. order do. labels =. labels,<(index{::KeywordWords),'/',number index{ranks end.
        8 grouped_lines labels
    case. ':groups' do.
        found =. 0$a:
        for_box. Groups do.
            group =. >box
            if. (0{args)e.1{::group do. found =. found,0{group end.
        end.
        if. #found do. <' ' join /:~found else. <'none' end.
    case. ':find' do.
        word =. 0{::args
        output =. 0$a:
        if. (<word)e.KeywordWords do.

            output =. <'keyword rank ',number 1{::key
        end.
        for_kind. i.2 do.
            if. kind do. substitutions =. Posts
            else. substitutions =. Pres end.
            label =. kind{::'pre';'post'
            for_box. substitutions do.
                'source replacement line' =. >box
                if. (word-:source)+.(<word)e.replacement do.
                    output =. output,<label,' ',(number line),': ',source,' -> ',' ' join replacement
                end.
            end.
        end.
        for_box. Groups do.
            'group members line' =. >box

        end.
        for_box. Keywords do.

                'label index ruleid' =. >entrybox
                if. (<word)e.1{::ruleid{::Rules do. output =. output,<'pattern ',(0{::key),' ',label,' ',number index end.
            end.

    case. ':script' do.

        for_box. entries do.
            rule =. (2{::>box){::Rules

            for_itemid. 3{::rule do. numbers =. numbers,3{::itemid{::Items end.
        end.

            end.

        end.
        if. #output do. output else. <'no rules' end.
    case. ':reset' do.
        cycle_reset ''
        <'cycles reset'
    case. ':unused' do.
        numbers =. 0$0
        for_index. I.ItemUses=0 do. numbers =. numbers,3{::index{::Items end.
        output =. <'unused ',number #numbers

    end.
)

            code =. 'SYNTAX'
            message =. 'bad arguments for ',name
        elseif. ((<name)e.RuleDirectives)*.currentkeyword=_1 do.
            code =. 'ORPHAN'

        elseif. (<name)e.MoveDirectives do.

            if. -.orphan do. orphan =. 'MEMORY'-:0{::currentrule{::Rules end.

        if. (<name)e.TextDirectives do.

        elseif. name-:'QUIT' do. QuitWords =: ~.QuitWords,args

            else.

            end.
